domain: Domain X is tagged calls Lens(W;E) or Means(L), with finite supplied Word sequence W, fixed compiled expression snapshot E and arbitrary finite Reading/Lens values L. No live lexical learning occurs. Let M=expressions_in_sentence(lower(forms W),lower(lemmas W);E). Lens maps each match m in M order to (join(original forms W[m.start..m.end],space),phrase,kind,meaning,register); its domains are sorted unique union of m.domains. Means selects readings whose phrase contains ASCII space, renders text + ' = ' + meaning stripped of every trailing period, joins with '; ', or returns '-' when selection is empty.
state: For Lens calls, reading count/order equal M count/order; text uses original surfaces, and domains=sort(unique(union domains(M))). For Means calls, only selected readings contribute, in order with multiplicity; empty selection yields '-'. Source-matcher span validity is a dependency premise.
